# Sonata — Full AI Agent & Developer Reference (v7.7.0)

> **App:** https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz  
> **Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0):** https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp  
> **Compact Index:** https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/llms.txt  

Sonata is an offline-first, zero-database Progressive Web App (vanilla ES modules + JSDoc TypeScript checking + Vite/Workbox PWA) for musicians, singers, bands, and worship teams to write, auto-format, transpose, present on stage, and share chord charts. Songs reside locally (`sonata:v12:*` LocalStorage + IndexedDB snapshots) and sync optionally with the user's own Google Drive (`sonata_library.json`, `drive.file` app-scoped permission).

---

## 1. Sonata Architecture & Data Model

### Core Modules (`js/core/`)
- `js/core/music.js` — Pitch classes, 24 major/minor keys, key scoring (`detectKey`), enharmonic spelling, transposition (`transposeText`), chord parsing (`parseChord` supporting slash bass typos like `D/F#m`, glued hyphens `Bm///-`, cues `(hold)`, `add2`/`add4`/`sus`).
- `js/core/chart.js` — Line classification (`chords`, `inline`, `section`, `note`, `divider`, `lyrics`), Concert-Key + Capo normalization (`resolveImportedKey`), `autoFormatChart(raw, opts)`, `analyzeRawChart(raw)`, `buildLines` (supporting `chords`, `chords-only`, `nashville`, `roman`, `lyrics`).
- `js/core/import.js` — Safe public-HTTPS scraper & extractor (`extractChart`, `htmlToText`, `stripAsciiTabLines`) with support for Ultimate Guitar, WorshipTogether, PraiseCharts, Chordify, LaCuerda, AZChords, UkuTabs, EssentialWorship, MultiTracks, HTML `<td>`/`<th>` tables, and Next.js `__NEXT_DATA__` payloads.
- `js/core/store.js` — Library state (`songs`, `setlists`, `trash`, `settings`), 30-day soft-delete Trash, deterministic `libraryFingerprint()` with backward compatibility (`genre`, `mood`, `bank`, `trash`).
- `js/core/share.js` — Deflate + base64url `?s=` compact share encoder (`packSong`, `packSet`, `encodeShare`, `decodeShare`, max URL size caps, safe `http(s)` links).
- `js/core/mcp-tools.js` — Isomorphic zero-DOM / zero-`node:*` schemas, `annotations`, and executors for all **18 MCP tools**.

### Canonical Song Schema
- `id`: string
- `title`: string
- `artist`: string
- `creator`: string (arranger)
- `body`: string (Markdown-like chord chart)
- `manualKey`: `"auto"` or `"<Root>:<major|minor>"` (e.g. `"D:major"`, `"F#:minor"`)
- `capo`: integer `0..11` (fret)
- `transpose`: integer `-11..11` (non-destructive semitones)
- `bpm`: integer `30..300` or `null`
- `genre`: optional string (<= 40 chars)
- `mood`: optional string (<= 30 chars, e.g. `Joyful`, `Solemn`, `Reflective`, `Anthemic`, `Intimate`, `Upbeat`)
- `description`: optional notes
- `links`: `{ name: string, url: string }[]`
- `isFavorite`: boolean
- `inBank`: boolean

### Canonical Chart Syntax (`SONATA_FORMAT_GUIDE`)
- `## Section` — Neutral section pill badge (`## Verse 1`, `## Chorus`, `## Pre-Chorus`, `## Bridge`, `## Intro`, `## Outro`, `## Tag`, `## Instrumental`, `## Interlude`).
- Chords above lyrics (preserve column spacing) or inline bracketed `[G]Amazing [D/F#]grace`.
- Rhythm slashes `G///`, `D/// -`, neutral tokens `|`, `/`, `%`, `N.C.`, `x2`.
- Notes: `> Cue` or `// Cue` (hidden in `lyrics` and `chords-only` modes); `---` section divider.

---

## 2. MCP Tools Reference (18 Total · MCP 2025-03-26)

Every tool exposes standard MCP `annotations`: `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, `openWorldHint`.

### Public Tools (7 — Anonymous Access Allowed)
1. **`extract_chords_from_url`** *(readOnly, idempotent, openWorld)*
   - Input: `{ url: string }` (public HTTPS only; private/loopback/link-local hosts rejected).
   - Output: `{ title, artist, manualKey, capo, bpm, links, body, chords, keyName, romanSummary, source }`.
2. **`analyze_chord_chart`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: `{ rawChart: string, sourceUrl?: string }`.
   - Output: structured metadata + cleaned `body` + detected `keyName` + `chords`.
3. **`format_chord_chart`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: `{ rawChart: string, maxCols?: number (36..100, default 58), wrap?: boolean (default true), sourceUrl?: string }`.
   - Output: normalized Markdown chart (`## Section`, repaired chords, collapsed chord/lyric gaps, stripped voicing/tab legends, balanced wrapped pairs), metadata, and `changes` summary.
4. **`build_sonata_link`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: Single song fields (`title`, `body`, `artist`, `creator`, `key`, `capo`, `transpose`, `bpm`, `genre`, `mood`, `description`, `links`) OR `{ title, description, links, songs: [...] }` for a setlist link.
   - Output: `{ url: "https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/?s=...", type: "song"|"setlist", title }`.
5. **`lookup_chord`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: `{ chord: string, instrument?: "all"|"guitar"|"ukulele"|"bass"|"piano" }`.
   - Output: `{ name, root, quality, label, slashBass, notes, bassNote, formula, intervals, pcs, guitar?, ukulele?, bass?, piano? }`.
6. **`transpose_chart`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: `{ body: string, steps?: number (-11..11), fromKey?: string, toKey?: string, viewMode?: "chords"|"chords-only"|"nashville"|"roman"|"lyrics", enharmonic?: "auto"|"sharp"|"flat" }`.
   - Output: `{ text, fromKey, toKey, steps, viewMode, chords }`.
7. **`get_key_info`** *(readOnly, idempotent, closedWorld)*
   - Input: `{ key: string }`.
   - Output: scale notes, signature, relative major/minor key, diatonic chords, chord families.

### Authenticated Library Tools (11 — Google Drive OAuth 2.1 or Local Store)
8. **`get_library_summary`** *(readOnly, idempotent)* — Counts (`songs`, `setlists`, `favorites`, `inBank`, `trash`) and 10 recent songs.
9. **`list_songs`** *(readOnly, idempotent)* — Filter by `query`, `genre`, `mood`, `favoritesOnly`, `inBankOnly`, `limit`, `offset`. Returns `{ id, title, artist, key, bpm, capo, genre, mood, isFavorite, inBank, updatedAt }`.
10. **`get_song`** *(readOnly, idempotent)* — Full song record by exact `id` or `query`, plus computed `soundingKey` and `soundingKeyShort`.
11. **`create_song`** *(mutating)* — Accepts `title`, `artist`, `creator`, `body` or `rawChart`, `key`, `capo`, `transpose`, `bpm`, `genre`, `mood`, `description`, `links`, `isFavorite`, `inBank`.
12. **`import_song_from_url`** *(mutating, openWorld)* — Fetches `url` (or parses `rawChart`), deduplicates against existing titles/URLs unless `allowDuplicate: true`.
13. **`update_song`** *(mutating, idempotent)* — Updates metadata (`title`, `key`, `capo`, `bpm`, `genre`, `mood`, ...) or `body`, plus permanent `transposeBy`.
14. **`trash_song`** *(mutating, idempotent)* — Soft-deletes `ids[]` to 30-day Trash preserving setlist placements.
15. **`list_trash`** *(readOnly, idempotent)* — Lists trashed songs/setlists with `trashedAt` and `expiresAt`.
16. **`restore_from_trash`** *(mutating, idempotent)* — Restores trashed `ids[]` cleanly back to active songs/setlists.
17. **`empty_trash`** *(mutating, destructiveHint: true, idempotent)* — Returns dry-run preview unless `confirm: true` is passed after user confirmation.
18. **`manage_setlists`** *(mutating)* — Actions: `list`, `create`, `update`, `add_songs` (deduped), `trash` (30-day soft delete).

### Prompts & Resources
- Resource: `sonata://format-guide` (`text/markdown`)
- Prompt: `import_chords_from_link` (`url`)

---

## 3. Authentication & Client Connection Quickstarts

### Remote MCP (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE S256)
- Endpoint: `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp`
- Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
- Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`
- DCR (RFC 7591): `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/oauth/register`

### Platform Quickstarts
- **Gemini / Gemini Tasks (`settings.json`):** `{ "mcpServers": { "sonata": { "httpUrl": "https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp" } } }`
- **Antigravity:** Connect `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp` via HTTP MCP, or run `node scripts/sonata-cli.mjs mcp --local /path/to/sonata_library.json`.
- **Claude Desktop / Claude Connectors / Claude Code:** Add custom remote connector `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp`, or run `claude mcp add --transport http sonata https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp`.
- **OpenAI / ChatGPT Connectors & Codex CLI (`~/.codex/config.toml`):** `[mcp_servers.sonata]` -> `url = "https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp"`, or add `https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz/api/mcp` as an MCP connector app.
- **Browser WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`):** Open https://sonata.jethrofrane.xyz in Chromium/WebMCP-enabled agent browsers or call `window.sonataAgent.call(name, args)`.
